name: ai-software-delivery-room
description: Multi-agent software delivery for Claude: discovery with features, end-to-end process flows and test cases; architecture; sprints sliced through whole user journeys with independent QA; Playwright, Cypress and Selenium tests you can watch live; private test reports and user-reviewed manuals; a project dashboard with a delivery forecast and a client status report; and assessments of existing systems, with a parity gate when you rebuild them.
